name: Scroll of Fireball
description: A crackling scroll that unleashes a fireball dealing 25 damage to all in the area.

name: Scroll of Teleportation
description: Teleports the reader to a safe location. Ideal for escaping danger.

name: Scroll of Identify
description: Reveals the true properties of a mysterious item.

name: Scroll of Enchantment
description: Temporarily enchants a weapon with +3 attack for 10 turns.

name: Scroll of Summoning
description: Summons a temporary ally to fight alongside the reader.
